title: Продажи за день
description: Пример бизнес-отчёта; адаптируйте таблицу и поля под схему компании.
sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS orders_count, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CAST(:report_date AS DATE) AND created_at < CAST(:report_date AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY department ORDER BY revenue DESC
